about.body: The S85 is BMW M's naturally aspirated 5.0-litre V10 engine, produced between 2005 and 2010. It's one of the most distinctive engines BMW M has ever built — the only production V10 ever fitted to a BMW-badged car — and powers two of the brand's most celebrated performance models: the E60/E61-generation M5 and the E63/E64-generation M6. The S85's high-revving character and Formula 1-inspired architecture set it apart from the turbocharged V8s that followed, and it remains a cult favourite among BMW M enthusiasts. Our workshop experience on this engine spans both the M5 and M6 applications, and we rebuild them to factory specification.

byModel.body: The S85 appears in exactly two BMW models. In the M5, it powered the E60 saloon and E61 Touring across the full 2005–2010 production run. In the M6, it appeared in the E63 coupe and E64 convertible across 2006–2010. Both applications use the same base engine, though specific ancillaries and mounting differ between the two models — a factor we account for during any rebuild.

compatibility.body: Because the S85 was fitted to only two models — the E60/E61 M5 and E63/E64 M6 — compatibility is simpler than with more broadly-deployed engines, but it still comes down to confirming your exact model and chassis. An S85 from an M5 isn't automatically a drop-in match for an S85 from an M6, even though it's the same base engine code — ancillaries and mounting differ. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm your exact vehicle.
